profile_note: SC1 speaker and renderer controls are not calibrated for a Lil-aware dialogue profile. Raphael's profile must not be reused. Every translated record remains blocked from fixed encoding and release until its complete leading state and route macro behavior are mapped.

allocation_precheck.method: Conservative lower bound: one source-state byte plus editable ASCII bytes, with FI/FA/FO counted as their two source command bytes. Automatic breaks, protective bytes, padding, and route-specific macro expansion are excluded.
allocation_precheck.note: This lower-bound list is populated by the source/allocation audit. All records remain blocked even when the draft is shorter than the source allocation; omission from the overflow list is not proof of fit after Lil-aware formatting.
